title: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group Inc. Trims Holdings in Meta Platforms, Inc. $META
summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group Inc. reduced its stake in Meta Platforms by 6.9% in the third quarter of 2025, selling 5,222 shares to hold 70,383 shares valued at approximately $51.69 million. title: Meta Tests AI Tool That Finds Products Based On Your Profile
summary: Meta Platforms is expanding its AI ecosystem by testing a new AI shopping research tool within its chatbot, which suggests products based on user profiles. The company is also strengthening its AI infrastructure with a new applied AI engineering organization and signing content licensing deals with news publishers like News Corp. Despite facing investor skepticism over AI spending, analysts believe Meta has long-term upside potential, citing upcoming AI model launches and cost efficiencies.

title: Meta platforms CFO Susan Li sells $36.4m in shares By Investing.com
summary: Meta Platforms CFO Susan J. Li, through the Li-Hegeman Family Foundation, sold 55,571 shares of Class A Common Stock for approximately $36.4 million. The sale, executed under a pre-arranged trading plan, occurred on February 27, 2026, with Meta trading near its InvestingPro Fair Value. Following the transaction, the foundation holds no direct shares, though Li retains an indirect holding through a living trust.

summary: This article compiles various trading ideas and technical analyses for Meta Platforms Inc. (META) from multiple contributors on TradingView. title: First Financial Bankshares Inc Has $62.59 Million Stake in Meta Platforms, Inc. $META
summary: First Financial Bankshares Inc has increased its stake in Meta Platforms, Inc. by 8.6%, now owning 85,231 shares valued at $62.59 million, making it their 29th largest holding. Despite this, significant insider selling occurred this quarter, with the CTO and CFO offloading over 100,000 shares. Meta continues to show strong fundamentals, beating EPS estimates and expanding its AI investments, with analysts maintaining a "Moderate Buy" rating.

title: Meta Reportedly Signs $50 Million News Corp Deal As Big Tech's AI Content Arms Race Heats Up
summary: Meta Platforms has reportedly signed a three-year, $50 million per year content licensing deal with News Corp to fuel its AI products and train its systems. This agreement follows News Corp's prior AI deal with OpenAI and highlights the ongoing "arms race" among Big Tech companies to secure journalism for their AI endeavors. Meta is actively expanding its AI content partnerships, having previously inked deals with other major publishers like USA Today, CNN, and Reuters.

title: Meta Prepayment Puts Spotlight On Oklo’s Long Term SMR Potential
summary: Oklo (NYSE:OKLO) has secured a significant funding and power prepayment agreement with Meta Platforms for a future nuclear plant in Ohio. This deal involves Meta prepaying for electricity from Oklo's small modular reactor (SMR) project, providing crucial capital ahead of commercial operations and validating the SMR business model for data center power needs. While Oklo is still pre-commercial with associated risks, this long-term contract with a major corporation is seen as a positive step for financing and project planning, potentially influencing other large power buyers.

title: Smart glasses set to replace conventional eyewear, Value Line argues
summary: Mark Zuckerberg believes smart glasses will soon replace traditional eyewear, a sentiment echoed by Value Line. This shift indicates a move towards integrating wearable technology into daily life, offering advanced features beyond basic vision correction. The development could significantly impact the optics market, ushering in more immersive and connected user experiences.

title: Analysis of Risks and Opportunities in Invesco QQQ ETF Investment
summary: The Invesco QQQ ETF presents opportunities for long-term growth due to advancements in AI and other emerging technologies, despite significant concentration risk with nearly half its assets in its top ten holdings, Nvidia being 8.4%. The ETF also offers a low expense ratio compared to its peers. Investors are advised to consider portfolio diversity and risk, as analysts suggest other stocks might be better investment choices.

title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Signs Multi-Year Meta AI Deal
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) has signed a multi-year agreement with Meta Platforms for over $100 billion in AI computing capacity. This partnership is viewed positively by analysts D.A. Davidson and TD Cowen, who reiterated their ratings with price targets of $220 and $290 respectively. The deal includes 6 gigawatts of AI compute capacity and customization components, similar to AMD's previous arrangement with OpenAI.

title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Signs Multi-Year Meta AI Deal
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) has signed a multi-year agreement with Meta Platforms for over $100 billion in AI computing capacity. title: London & Capital Asset Management Ltd Buys 48,852 Shares of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. $AMD
summary: London & Capital Asset Management Ltd increased its stake in Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) by 30.8%, now owning 207,654 shares valued at $33.60 million. Su and other executives, analysts remain largely bullish on AMD, with a consensus price target of approximately $290.53 following strong quarterly earnings and strategic partnerships.

title: Abbott Labs Finishes Off Suit Over Google, Meta Data Sharing
summary: Abbott Laboratories Inc. has successfully defended against a proposed class action lawsuit, which alleged the company improperly shared consumers' protected health data with Meta Platforms Inc. and Google LLC. A US District Court judge dismissed the case with prejudice, stating that the plaintiffs failed to adequately substantiate claims of negligence and violations of the Electronic Communications Privacy Act and the California Invasion of Privacy Act. The lawsuit was brought by three consumers involved in a blood-glucose monitoring device free trial.

title: Piper Sandler and Jefferies Stay Bullish on Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) After Meta Deal
summary: Piper Sandler and Jefferies have reiterated their bullish stance on Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) following a significant multi-year chip supply deal with Meta Platforms. Piper Sandler projects the deal could generate about $100 billion in revenue for AMD over the next five years, expecting analysts to raise their estimates. Jefferies noted the deal's similarity to a previous agreement with OpenAI, recognizing that such strategic partnerships, while costly, are crucial for market presence and future business for the semiconductor company.

title: Meta Reportedly Signs $50 Million News Corp Deal As Big Tech's AI Content Arms Race Heats Up
summary: Meta Platforms has reportedly signed an AI content licensing deal with News Corp worth up to $50 million annually for at least three years, as tech giants compete for journalistic content to power their AI tools. This agreement grants Meta access to News Corp's content archives from the US and UK for its AI products and training. Other companies like OpenAI have also forged significant partnerships with publishers, highlighting the escalating arms race for content in the AI industry.

title: Oracle, OpenAI Scrap Texas AI Data Center Expansion Plans; Meta Eyes Site: Report
summary: Oracle and OpenAI have reportedly abandoned their plans to expand an AI data center in Abilene, Texas, due to financing issues and OpenAI's changing demand forecasts. This unexpected development has opened the door for Meta Platforms to consider leasing the site. Nvidia played a role in facilitating discussions between Meta and the data center developer, Crusoe, with Nvidia having previously paid a significant deposit for the expansion.

title: Tesla gains after BofA jumps back in with a bull rating (TSLA:NASDAQ)
summary: Bank of America has reinstated its "Buy" rating on Tesla (TSLA), citing the company's leadership in consumer autonomy. The firm highlighted Tesla's potential to quickly become a leader in robotaxi services. This positive analyst coverage led to gains in Tesla's stock.

title: BYD Sales Collapse. What About Tesla?
summary: BYD, the world's largest electric vehicle maker, reported a 41% year-on-year drop in February sales, driven by a 65% decline in domestic sales in China, despite surging export sales. This collapse, largely unexplained by the Lunar New Year, points to intense competition and price wars in the Chinese EV market. The article suggests that if BYD's struggles in China are indicative, Tesla, which also faces declining market share in China, the EU, and the US, could be in for a rough year.

title: Tesla (TSLA) Up or Down on March 3? Trading Odds & Predictions (Mar. 3, 2026)
summary: Polymarket hosted a prediction market on whether Tesla's (TSLA) NASDAQ closing price on March 3, 2026, would be higher or lower than the previous trading day's close. The market resolved to "Down," indicating that TSLA's closing price on that date was lower. The market generated $15,743 in trading volume, with participants betting on the daily price movement of TSLA.

title: Will Tesla's Cybertruck AWD Price Hike of 17% Sustain Demand Momentum?
summary: Tesla has increased the price of its Cybertruck AWD by 17% to $69,990, just 10 days after its introduction at $59,990. This price hike brings the AWD model above the inflation-adjusted equivalent of Tesla's original 2019 dual motor estimate. The article questions whether this new pricing will maintain demand momentum, given that Cybertruck sales have already fallen short of initial projections.

title: Tesla UK car sales drop 37% as Chinese competition heightens, SMMT data shows
summary: Tesla's UK sales fell by 37% in February compared to the previous year, with 2,422 vehicles sold, while overall new car sales in the UK increased by 7.2%. This decline is attributed to heightened competition from Chinese EV manufacturers like BYD, although Tesla asserts that quarterly registration figures provide a more accurate representation of sales. Despite BYD's significant sales increase, its overall volume still lags behind Tesla.

title: Billionaire Tesla whale says he bought 1 million Nvidia shares
summary: Billionaire Leo KoGuan, a major individual shareholder of Tesla, announced he purchased 1 million shares of Nvidia, with plans to buy another million, expressing strong belief in the AI market. Despite increasing skepticism about Elon Musk and Tesla's decisions, KoGuan stated he remains heavily invested in Tesla and treasury bills, viewing Tesla as a leading embodied AI company. KoGuan, who made his fortune from SHI International Corp., began investing in Tesla in 2019.

title: Tesla’s Secret Weapon Is a Giant Metal Box
summary: While Elon Musk focuses Tesla's future on Cybercabs and humanoid robots, the company's energy division, particularly the Megapack battery, is quietly becoming its most significant asset. Amid declining car sales and unproven robot technologies, the Megapack is poised to power the growing AI data center industry and provide Tesla with crucial cash flow, making Musk a potential "energy baron" in the AI arms race. This shift highlights how Tesla's less glamorous, yet highly effective, battery technology is driving its near-term success and strategic importance.

title: Tesla's UK sales plummet in February but outpace BYD, New Automotive data shows
summary: Tesla's UK sales dropped by 45.2% in February 2026, selling 2,208 vehicles, yet still managed to outsell Chinese rival BYD, which saw a 40.9% increase to 968 units. The decline in Tesla's sales points to broader challenges in Europe and intensifying competition from Chinese brands. Overall UK car registrations across all fuel types increased by 3.6% in the same month.

title: Elon Musk Says Tesla Will Be One Of The Companies To Develop AGI, Reaffirms Humanoid Robot Ambitions: 'Probably The First To…'
summary: Elon Musk has stated his belief that Tesla will be among the pioneering companies in developing Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), specifically aiming to be the first to create it in humanoid/atom-shaping form. He also reiterated ambitious plans for Tesla's Optimus Humanoid Robot, suggesting it could become a self-replicating von Neumann probe for space colonization. Additionally, Musk revealed progress in Tesla's in-house AI chip development, targeting a 2nm chip fabrication unit.

title: Elon Musk's Tesla Loses Toyota, Stellantis From EU Carbon Credits Pool: Report
summary: Tesla has reportedly lost Toyota and Stellantis from its EU carbon credits pool, impacting a significant revenue stream for the company. Toyota aims to reduce emissions independently through new electric vehicle offerings, while Stellantis plans to form its own pool with Leapmotor. This news comes as Tesla faces declining sales in Europe and other financial pressures.

title: Elon Musk’s ‘self-driving’ delusions get a reality check
summary: A California state administrative judge ruled that Tesla misled consumers regarding its "Autopilot" and "Full Self-Driving" capabilities, leading the DMV to threaten license suspension. Despite subsequently rebranding its FSD subscription to "Full Self-Driving (Supervised)" and the DMV backing off, Tesla is now suing to reverse the ruling, insisting on using its original terminology. This legal battle highlights the ongoing conflict between Tesla's marketing claims and the real-world limitations and safety concerns of its Level 2 autonomous driving technology, which has been linked to numerous fatal accidents.

title: Tesla Sales Rebound In Key European Markets, But Why Are Prediction Markets Still Bearish?
summary: Tesla has seen a rebound in sales in several key European markets like France, Spain, and Norway during February, breaking a 13-month losing streak, largely due to the introduction of cheaper Model Y and Model 3 versions. Despite this positive sales data, prediction market traders remain bearish on Tesla's Q1 deliveries and the likelihood of its future autonomous driving and robotics initiatives, suggesting that the stock's valuation is increasingly decoupling from its core car business. Analysts like Wedbush's Dan Ives maintain a bullish outlook on the stock, contrasting with the skepticism seen in prediction markets.

title: New Tesla sales in Spain surge 74% year-on-year in February
summary: New Tesla car sales in Spain rose by 73.7% in February compared to the same month in 2025, reaching 1,595 vehicles. For the first two months of 2026, Tesla sales in Spain saw a 72.9% increase year-on-year, while total electrified vehicle sales grew by 55.6%. This data comes from registration figures released by the industry group ANFAC.

title: Tesla gains market in France, Norway in February
summary: Tesla saw improvements in its market share in February in France and Norway, indicating a potential stabilization after two years of declining sales in Europe. Registrations for Tesla vehicles increased by 55% in France and 32% in Norway, even as many competitors experienced sales decreases. This uptick follows the introduction of cheaper versions of its Model Y and Model 3, though Tesla's overall market share in the EU, Britain, and EFTA still remains significantly lower than previous years.

title: Tesla Hit With Class Action Over Model S Electronic Door Handle Design
summary: Tesla is facing a class action lawsuit over the electronic door handle design in its 2023-present Model S vehicles. The lawsuit alleges that these handles pose a safety hazard, potentially trapping occupants during emergencies if the low-voltage power system fails. The plaintiff claims that the manual release mechanism for the rear doors is difficult to access and operate, making the vehicle "not reasonably escapable" after an accident.

title: Transce3nd LLC Sells 2,386 Shares of Tesla, Inc. $TSLA
summary: Transce3nd LLC significantly reduced its stake in Tesla by selling 2,386 shares, leaving it with 150 shares worth $67,000. This comes amidst other hedge funds adjusting their Tesla holdings and notable insider selling by directors Kathleen Wilson-Thompson and James R. Murdoch. The article also details mixed catalysts and risks for Tesla, including potential European expansion versus softening China demand and regulatory scrutiny.

title: Tesla Sweden appeals after grid company refuses to restore existing Supercharger due to union strike
summary: Tesla Sweden is challenging a Swedish power grid company's refusal to reconnect an operational Supercharger station in Åre, citing ongoing union sympathy actions. The station was temporarily disconnected for safety reasons, but despite repairs, the grid company, Jämtkraft elnät, will not restore power, arguing it falls under the union's measures against Tesla's charging infrastructure. Tesla maintains that reconnecting an existing facility is not covered by the sympathy actions, and the grid company states it is acting based on advice from its employer organization regarding the unique situation.

title: Austin shooting suspect was Tesla employee who assaulted co-worker, lawsuit says
summary: A lawsuit has been filed against Tesla by a former employee, Lillian Mendoza Brady, alleging that the company failed to provide a safe work environment and ignored warning signs about Ndiaga Diagne, the suspect in a recent Austin mass shooting. Brady claims Diagne assaulted her at the Gigafactory Texas in December and that Tesla refused to disclose his identity, which she only learned after the mass shooting. The lawsuit seeks over $1 million, suggesting Tesla's inaction might have prevented both the assault and the later mass shooting.

title: German union aims for breakthrough at Tesla Berlin plant
summary: Germany's top industrial union, IG Metall, is seeking greater influence at Tesla's gigafactory near Berlin as staff vote for a new works council. The union, which currently holds 16 of 39 seats, aims to secure a simple majority of 19 out of 37 seats in the new council. Tensions between IG Metall and Tesla management have been high, with the union accusing management of anti-union sentiment and Tesla countering that IG Metall is focused primarily on boosting its membership.

title: Tesla boosted Elon Musk's wealth and U.S. inequality, analysis argues
summary: Oxfam analysis claims Tesla's pay structure, tax practices, and political influence have contributed to Elon Musk's wealth and increased U.S. inequality. The report highlights Musk's vastly higher pay compared to employees, the company's use of tax havens, and alleged lack of corporate oversight. Oxfam advocates for increased corporate transparency and reforms to address such wealth disparities.
